verdict.rationale: Orb is a billing SaaS, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents no built-in assistant inside the Orb UI. The only AI-related evidence is a hosted MCP server that lets external agents call Orb's API, which is a separate MCP-server capability and a developer building block, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
